summary: Sandbach United kicked off the 2026/27 season today with their first league fixture against newcomers Wednesfield CFC, hoping to secure all three points in front of what they're calling for to be a bumper crowd. The club has been busy securing multiple new sponsors across their kit including front-of-shirt sponsors Fidenti Mortgages & Protection Ltd, and they're also highlighting their partnership with Visyon, a local mental health charity that will appear on the back of home shirts. Come along to support the Ramblers with affordable ticket prices of just £6 for adults and £5 for concessions!
